title: Most Valuable Parentheses
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \le T \le 500; 1 \le N \le 2 \times 10^{5}; For each input file, the sum of N over all test cases is at most 2 \times 10^{5}.; 0 \le A_i \le 10^{9} (1 \le i \le 2N); All input values are integers.
